rows.definition: Method on cudaQwen35PagedSequence (internal/compute/cuda_qwen35_sequence_paged.go) that computes causal GQA attention for one Qwen3.5 sequence lane over paged KV blocks: it gathers the layer's K/V pages into contiguous scratch, runs the qwen35 causal-attention panel kernel, and allocates its own output when none is supplied (it delegates to attentionIntoLocked). The 'Locked' suffix is the backend naming convention: the caller already holds the CUDA device mutex (cudaMu), as Qwen35SequencePrefill does, so the helper never re-acquires it.
rows.distinction: It is a lock-convention kernel helper on one device, NOT a state flag or a rank count: unlike graphOnceAttentionLocked (the CUDA graph-capture attention seam) and stagedAttentionLocked (the FP8 qualification-only helper), it is the live paged prefill/decode compute path, and unlike TPConfig.AttnRanks it computes attention on one device instead of sharding it across ranks.

rows.definition: Field on model.TPConfig (internal/model/tensor_parallel_forward.go): the number of tensor-parallel ranks the attention sublayer is sharded over, by KV-head group, in ForwardTP. ForwardTP clamps it to [1, NumKVHeads] via clampRanks before NewTPPlan builds the head-shard plan; 0 or negative means 1 (monolithic attention).
rows.distinction: It is a sharding-dimension COUNT on the forward config, NOT a per-request rank list or routing table: it parameterizes the Megatron attention-shard implementation (tensor_parallel_attn.go) and sits beside its siblings FFNRanks (shards the FFN intermediate dim) and VocabRanks (shards the vocab/LM-head axis via tpVocabPlan).
